in_sanskrit.name: ग्रीष्म
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Greeshma is derived from the Sanskrit word ग्रीष्म (grīṣma), which refers to the summer season. This season is characterized by the presence of the sun, heat, and monsoon rains. The word grīṣma comes from the root ग्रीष् (grīṣ), which means 'to be hot'. Thus, the name Greeshma can be seen as a symbol of the warmth and vitality of the summer season.

in_hindi.name: ग्रीष्मा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Greeshma in Hindi is ग्रीष्मा (grīṣmā). The meaning of the name is 'summer' or 'season'. In the Hindu calendar, the month of Shravana (July-August) is associated with the summer season and is named after the goddess Shravani, who is believed to bring rains during this time. Thus, the name Greeshma can be seen as a tribute to the nurturing power of the summer season.

in_tamil.name: கிருஷ்மா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Greeshma in Tamil is கிருஷ்மா (kiruṣmā). The meaning of the name is 'doing' or 'action'. In Hindu mythology, the god Vishnu is known by the name கிருஷ் (kiruṣ), which means 'doer' or 'performer'. Thus, the name Greeshma can be seen as a reflection of the active and creative force that drives all existence.

in_telugu.name: గ్రీష్మ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Greeshma in Telugu is గ్రీష్మ (grīṣma). The meaning of the name is 'goddess of wealth'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth and prosperity, is often referred to as గృష్మేశ్వరీ (grīṣmēśvarī). Thus, the name Greeshma can be seen as an invocation of the abundant blessings and good fortune that the goddess Lakshmi bestows upon her devotees.
